name: bg-bubbles
blurb: 250 shimmering spheres drift in an animated three.js gradient space.
description: Three.js WebGL scene with shader-based gradient material. Renders 250 animated spheres with temperature-based color blending transitioning between cool and warm palettes.
use_when: Premium hero section with cutting-edge 3D animated background.
avoid_when: Low-end devices, browsers without WebGL, or performance-critical pages.
a11y: Purely decorative 3D animation; no interaction or keyboard control.
